hook: Saudi flights *paused till Nov 14*. Your ticket can move to Nov 29.
hook_b: Saudi flights *paused till Nov 14*. Your ticket can move to Nov 29.
tldr: Air India and Air India Express extended the suspension of Saudi flights till November 14.

beats.what: NDTV reports Air India and Air India Express extended the Saudi Arabia flights suspension till Nov 14.
beats.why: Passengers with confirmed bookings issued on or before Oct 30 for travel up to Nov 14 can reschedule to travel up to Nov 29, subject to seat availability.
beats.care: If you or family fly to Saudi before Nov 14, rebook through the airline now. Seats on new dates are not guaranteed.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: NDTV: the suspension runs till Nov 14; bookings made on or before Oct 30 can be rescheduled up to Nov 29, subject to availability. The reason for the suspension was not in the summary.

cards.q: Saudi flights paused again. What do you want from the airline?

learn.t: Rescheduling means moving to a new date without cancelling and losing the fare, within the airline's window.

sources.name: NDTV
sources.title: Air India, Air India Express Extend Saudi Flights Suspension Till November 14

insight: Bookings made by Oct 30 can shift up to 15 days past the pause, if seats are free.
